name: [NEW!] Pet Legacy
desc:
Welcome to the world of Pet Legacy, capture wild pets as you adventure with your friends. Who will capture the rarest of them all? The journey awaits you!

[🌋VOLCANO UPDATE] 
Added a new zone with 4 new pets!
💰 Click wild pets to attack them!
🐲 Once you defeat a wild pet, use capsules to capture it!
🗺️ Discover new biomes!
✔️ Collect and trade pets with other players!
😎 Collect HUNDREDS of unique pets!

🔔Follow the game for game updates!🔔
